notes.title: Release Magicians' Legacy: Prologue
notes.notes:
Magicians' Legacy: Prologue is now available on Steam!
We`re looking forward to your thoughts and advice how to improve the game.
This prologue provides the minimum functionality of the game.
The main game will be 5 times greater and more diverse! There will be the construction of the tower and battles for the castle!
Meanwhile we offer you to get a view on the plot of the story and the gameplay mechanics!
Have a nice game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1448520
